chapterFiles.title: Exodus 3 — The burning bush + the divine-name revelation (ehyeh asher ehyeh)
Exodus 13 — The consecration of the firstborn + the pillar of cloud and fire
Exodus 14 — The parting of the sea + the destruction of Pharaoh's host
Exodus 16 — The manna and the quail
Exodus 17 — The water from the rock at Massah-Meribah + the battle with Amalek
Exodus 19 — The Sinai theophany (the descent of YHWH on the mountain in fire, smoke, and trumpet-blast)
Exodus 20 — The Decalogue + the altar law
Exodus 24 — The covenant ratification + the elders see the Elohim of Yisra'el on Sinai
Exodus 25 — The oblation for the sanctuary + the ark, the mercy-seat, the table, and the lampstand
Exodus 33 — The tent of meeting outside the camp + 'no man shall see me and live'

sourceCitation: Sefaria v3 API (Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra), drawing on the Westminster Leningrad Codex (Public Domain) as the pointed Hebrew Masoretic base text. Cross-collation references: Childs 1974 *The Book of Exodus: A Critical, Theological Commentary* (OTL); Propp 1999/2006 *Exodus 1-18 / 19-40* (Anchor Bible 2 + 2A); Sarna 1991 *Exodus: The Traditional Hebrew Text with the New JPS Translation* (JPS Torah Commentary); Cassuto 1951/1967 *Commentary on the Book of Exodus* (Magnes-Hebrew University); Houtman 1993-2000 *Exodus* (Historical Commentary on the Old Testament, 4 vols); Dozeman 2009 *Commentary on Exodus* (Eerdmans); Sommer 2009 *The Bodies of God and the World of Ancient Israel* for the divine-presence theology of Ex 3 + 19.

subtitles.en: The ten Raëlian-canon-cited chapters: the burning bush, the firstborn and the pillar of cloud, the parting of the sea, the manna, the rock-water, the Sinai theophany and the Decalogue, the covenant meal on the mountain, the ark and the lampstand, and 'man shall not see me and live'

descriptions.en:
An English translation of the ten chapters of Exodus that the Raëlian canon cites, translated as whole chapters: **Exodus 3** (the burning bush and the revelation of the name), **13** (the firstborn and the pillar of cloud and fire), **14** (the parting of the sea), **16** (the manna), **17** (the water from the rock and Amalek), **19** (the Sinai theophany), **20** (the Decalogue), **24** (the covenant ratified, and the elders who see the Elohim of Yisra'el), **25** (the oblation for the sanctuary, the ark, the table and the lampstand) and **33** (the tent of meeting and 'no man shall see me and live'). The rest of the book is not translated.

Source: Sefaria v3 API, Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra (Westminster Leningrad Codex base, Public Domain). Reference translation: ASV (1901).
